name: AskaDedicatedServer
description: ASKA is a multiplayer survival game set in a mythical Viking Age world. This container runs a dedicated server for ASKA using Proton-GE for compatibility. REQUIREMENTS: - Authentication token from https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers for App ID: 1898300 - UDP ports 27015 and 27016 must be forwarded in your router SAVE MANAGEMENT: - Leave ASKA_SAVE_ID empty for new servers (auto-generated after first save) - For existing saves: place savegame_* folder in /aska-saves volume and delete server.properties.docker.txt - Save ID format: characters after 'savegame_' (e.g., bbdb7_1801262114211) CUSTOM MODE: - Set ASKA_MODE to 'custom' to enable advanced settings (terrain, seasons, difficulty, etc.) - Advanced settings must be configured in server.properties.docker.txt file For more information, visit the Docker Hub page.

paths.name: Server Data
paths.description: Server installation and data directory (contains server.properties.docker.txt for advanced customization)

paths.name: Save Files
paths.description: Directory for world saves and backups (savegame_* folders go here)

ports.name: Game Port (UDP)
ports.description: Steam game port - clients connect here for gameplay (must be forwarded in router)

ports.name: Query Port (UDP)
ports.description: Steam query port - manages server browser and client pings (must be forwarded in router)

variables.name: Server Display Name
variables.description: Name displayed in the session/server browser

variables.name: Server Internal Name
variables.description: Internal server identifier/hostname (use lowercase, hyphens allowed, no spaces)

variables.name: Authentication Token
variables.description: Steam GSL authentication token from https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers (App ID: 1898300). REQUIRED.

variables.name: Save ID
variables.description: Save ID from savegame folder name (e.g., bbdb7_1801262114211). Leave empty for new world or auto-detection. Auto-populated after first save.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password required to join the server (leave empty for no password)

variables.name: Region
variables.description: Server region: default (auto-ping best), asia, japan, europe, south america, south korea, usa east, usa west, australia, canada east, hong kong, india, turkey, united arab emirates, usa south central

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: normal = standard gameplay | custom = enables terrain, season, difficulty customization (edit server.properties.docker.txt for custom settings)

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players allowed on the server (1-4)

variables.name: World Seed
variables.description: World generation seed (leave empty for random)

variables.name: Keep World Alive
variables.description: true = world updates even with no players | false = world loads/unloads with players

variables.name: Autosave Style
variables.description: Options: every morning, disabled, every 5 minutes, every 10 minutes, every 15 minutes, every 20 minutes

variables.name: Worker Threads
variables.description: Unity worker threads - leave empty for auto (CPU cores - 1)

variables.name: Skip Steam Update
variables.description: Skip Steam updates on container start: 0 = update (recommended), 1 = skip updates

variables.name: Steam Validate
variables.description: Validate game files on start: 0 = no validation (faster), 1 = validate files (slower, fixes corruption)

variables.name: Enable Save Backup
variables.description: Enable automatic backup on container start: 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled

variables.name: Keep Backups
variables.description: Number of backup saves to retain (only applies when ASKA_SAVE_BACKUP=1)

variables.name: Crash Pattern
variables.description: Custom log pattern for crash detection (advanced users only - leave empty for default)
